title: Invalidate dependencies transitively including absence and candidate scopes
summary: Keep results current without reevaluating everything. Negative and candidate watches must detect new evidence whose identity did not exist when the original assessment ran.
implementation: Index revision reads and typed query/coverage/candidate-set watches.
Emit changes from core operations and match affected dependencies by scope.
Invalidate transitively with deduplicated reasons while preserving history.
Expose commit/dispatch freshness tokens and fence recomputations racing further changes.

acceptance.criterion: Later evidence invalidates an absence conclusion without a prior object ID.
acceptance.verification: Compare matching and unrelated arrivals against an empty-scope assessment.

acceptance.criterion: Association correction invalidates recurrence, claims, and queued descendants.
acceptance.verification: Inspect the exact transitive affected graph after regrouping.

acceptance.criterion: Unrelated audience changes leave independent evidence judgments current.
acceptance.verification: Compare manifests and affected IDs for two contexts.

tests: Source access loss invalidates required readable evidence.
Repeated change notices do not duplicate recomputation.
A recomputation racing correction cannot publish as fresh.
risks: Object-ID-only tracking misses new evidence and invalid negative conclusions.

reuse.application: Reuse read-version/transitive invalidation patterns after inspection without application state dependencies.
